spans.s: पृथ् vi. 10U (pres. पर्थयति-ते) 1. To throw, to cast; 2. to send.
पृथक् ind. 1. Separately, severally, शंखान् दध्मुः पृथक् पृथक् Bg.i.18; 2. with the exception of, except, (with an acc., inst. or abl.); 3. without.
पृथक्-आत्मता f. 1. severalty; 2. discrimination, distinction.
पृथक्-आत्मिका f. individual existence, individuality.
पृथक्-करण n. 1. separating, distinguishing; 2. analysing.
पृथक्-क्रिया f. 1. separating, distinguishing; 2. analysing.
पृथक्-कुल a. belonging to a different family.
पृथक्-क्षेत्र m. pl. children of one father but of different mothers.
पृथक्-चर a. going separately.
पृथक्-जन m. 1. a low man, an ordinary man, न पृथग्जनवच्छुचो वशं वशिनामुत्तमं गंतुमर्हसि R.vii.66; 2. a fool, an ignorant man; 3. a wicked man, a sinner.
पृथक्-त्व n. severalty, singleness.
पृथक्-भाव m. separateness, individuality.
पृथक्-रूप a. of different shapes or kinds.
पृथक्-विध a. of different kinds.
पृथक्-शय्या f. sleeping apart.
पृथक्-स्थिति f. separate existence.
पृथवी f. The same as पृथिवी q.v.
पृथा f. Name of Kuntī, one of the two wives of Pāṇḍu.
पृथा-ज, -तनय, -सुत, -सूनु m. an epithet of the first three Pāṇḍava princes, but especially of Arjuna, अभितस्तं पृथासूनुः स्नेहेन परितस्तरे Kir.xi.8.

पृथु (I) a. (f. थु or थ्वी; compar. प्रथीयस्; super. प्रथिष्ठ) 1. Wide, expansive, spacious, सिंधोः पृथुमपि तनुं दूरभावात्प्रवाहम् Megh.i.46; 2. ample, abundant; 3. great, large, R.xi.25; 4. numerous; 5. important.
पृथु (II) m. An epithet of Agni.
पृथु (III) f. Opium.

पृथ्वी f. 1. The earth; 2. the earth considered as one of the five elements; 3. large cardamoms; 4. name of a metre. (See App. I.)

पृथु-श्री a. highly prosperous.
पृथु-श्रोणि a. having large buttocks.
पृथु-संपद् a. rich, wealthy.
पृथु-स्कंध m. a hog.

पृथुक (II) m. A child.
